assets.narrative: The move is most consistent with a guidance-led re-rating. Asteron raised data-centre revenue expectations and announced a multi-year hyperscaler agreement; the stock outperformed its semiconductor benchmark on unusually high volume.

catalysts.headline: Management raises data-centre revenue outlook by 12%
catalysts.quote: We now expect data-centre revenue to grow 34–38% this fiscal year.
catalysts.interpretation: A material upward revision to the segment carrying the highest valuation sensitivity.

catalysts.headline: New accelerator supply agreement with a top-three cloud provider
catalysts.quote: Initial deployments begin next quarter under a multi-year capacity reservation.
catalysts.interpretation: Adds demand visibility and supports the durability of the guidance revision.

assets.narrative: The sell-off appears credit-driven rather than a broad regional-bank move. A sector-neutral abnormal return coincided with an unexpected reserve build and weaker office-loan commentary.

catalysts.headline: Novaridge announces an unplanned commercial-real-estate reserve build
catalysts.quote: The quarter will include a $118 million provision tied primarily to office exposure.
catalysts.interpretation: The magnitude was outside prior guidance and directly reduces near-term earnings.

catalysts.headline: Broker cuts estimates following reserve announcement
catalysts.quote: We reduce 2027 EPS by 9% and move the shares to Neutral.
catalysts.interpretation: A secondary catalyst that reinforced the initial credit shock after the open.

assets.narrative: Orbit’s outperformance is linked to a regulatory clearance that removes a launch dependency. The volume spike and positive follow-through suggest the market treated the announcement as economically meaningful.

catalysts.headline: Payments licence approved in two additional markets
catalysts.quote: Orbit Payments is authorised to provide merchant acquiring services.
catalysts.interpretation: Removes a key regulatory gate from the company’s international expansion plan.

catalysts.headline: Orbit confirms phased merchant rollout begins next month
catalysts.quote: The first cohort will include 1,200 small and mid-sized merchants.
catalysts.interpretation: Supports revenue optionality, though the phased schedule limits near-term contribution.
